integrity_notes: The self-review checks correctness, originality within inspected evidence, and mathematical value. Exact rational computations verify finite instances, but infinite claims rest on analytical proofs. Historical priority is provisional and independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unweighted wheel graphs and unrestricted induced endpoint norms; it does not cover weighted wheels, general graph joins or intermediate p-norms. Full Green-kernel formulas are prior results. The stated novel component is sign-threshold asymptotics and its nonconstant lattice phase.
title: Sharp wheel-graph Poisson amplification and its logarithmic lattice phase
